target: templates/.env.example — documents FORGE, FORGE_URL, FORGE_REMOTE, FORGE_TOKEN and GITLAB_TOKEN
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"
E="$PLUGIN_ROOT/templates/.env.example"
for v in FORGE FORGE_URL FORGE_REMOTE FORGE_TOKEN GITLAB_TOKEN; do
  if grep -qE "^#? *$v=" "$E"; then echo "$v=yes"; else echo "$v=no"; fi
done
